# Polish Architect UK

> ARB registered Polish architect based in Oxford, serving clients across the whole UK, with every service explained and delivered in Polish and English.

Polish Architect UK (Polski Architekt UK), led by Jakub Boronczyk MSc Dip Architect ARB, offers complete architectural design, planning permission (including listed buildings), UK Building Regulations and Building Safety Act compliance, Party Wall, CDM and Health & Safety, tender documentation and coordination, feasibility studies, interior and landscape design, and site project management. Work follows the RIBA Plan of Work.

Contact: phone 0748 12 44 212, email polskiarchitekt.UK@gmail.com.
